sections.kicker: Not every crack is the same
sections.heading: Hairline cracks and structural cracks need different fixes.
sections.body: Fine surface cracks are usually shrinkage or minor movement and can be filled and refinished. Wider or stepped cracks, or cracks running from window and door corners, can point to movement underneath, and those need opening up and rebuilding rather than a skim of filler.

sections.heading: The texture is what makes a repair disappear.
sections.body: Most Los Angeles homes have a sand, lace or smooth finish. A repair that is structurally sound but has the wrong texture still looks like a patch, so the finish coat is matched to the wall around it before colour goes on.

pages.seoDescription: Re-stucco and colour coat services in Los Angeles to refresh faded, patchy or heavily repaired stucco walls.

sections.heading: A colour coat resets the whole wall.
sections.body: When a house has years of patches in slightly different shades, or the colour has faded unevenly in the sun, repairing piece by piece never quite matches. A new finish coat over the sound base gives one even texture and colour across the wall.

sections.heading: The base has to be sound.
sections.body: A colour coat is a finish, not a fix. Loose, cracked or water-damaged areas are repaired first so the new coat bonds to solid stucco and does not crack along the old faults.

pages.heading: Stucco water damage repair.
pages.intro: Staining, bubbling and soft spots opened up so the cause is found and fixed.
pages.seoTitle: Stucco Water Damage Repair Los Angeles CA | Stucco Repair Los Angeles
pages.seoDescription: Stucco water damage repair in Los Angeles: stains, bubbling and soft areas opened up, the cause fixed and the wall rebuilt.

sections.heading: Stains, bubbling and crumbling near the base.
sections.body: Dark streaks below windows, bubbled or flaking paint, stucco that sounds hollow when tapped, and crumbling along the bottom of the wall are the usual signs that water is getting behind the finish.

sections.heading: Patching over wet stucco hides the problem.
sections.body: Water usually gets in at windows, roof lines, penetrations or a missing weep screed. The damaged section is opened, the paper and lath checked, the entry point dealt with, and the wall rebuilt so it can shed water again.
